Holy Ascension Skete, Russia 🇷🇺

Perched atop Sekirnaya Mountain on the Solovetsky Islands in the White Sea, the Holy Ascension Skete was built in the 19th century and remains one of Russia’s few active Orthodox lighthouse churches. Nestled within a landscape of raw northern beauty, it commands sweeping views of forested cliffs and rugged coastlines.

More than just a place of worship, this church once played a vital role at sea — its beacon guiding vessels through the treacherous waters of the Arctic. Today, the white-walled structure with its gilded dome continues to stand as a quiet sentinel, merging faith, history, and seafaring tradition into a single enduring symbol.

Here, the wind, the silence, and the endless expanse of sky and sea deepen a sense of solitude and spiritual ascent — a sacred outpost at the edge of the known world.
